## Build 35 independent Watchlist/notification source audit — 2026-11-02 (Agent 3)

**Source authority:** mobile integration `892f9ef08b29bbce68edffb96298b0a8bf65814a` (fresh branch readback). **Scope:** read-only review of `commerce-watch-refresh/index.ts`, `pushDelivery.ts`, `receiptProcessing.ts`, notification routing/registration and retained source tests. No Production/Staging calls, push sends, customers or changed runtime source.

### Source-supported finding candidate: Expo ticket accepted without positive ticket proof
- **Location:** `supabase/functions/commerce-watch-refresh/pushDelivery.ts:128–139`. After HTTP 200 the adapter checks only `ticket?.status === 'error'`; all other shapes, including `{data:[]}`, `{data:[{}]}`, `{data:[{status:'ok'}]}`, `{}`, or response JSON `null`, fall through to **`{attempted:true,ok:true,ticketId:undefined}`**.
- **Actual integration impact:** `index.ts:229–246` emits **`push_ticket_accepted`** on `result.ok`, but persists a pending receipt only if `result.ticketId`; malformed or unacknowledged sends can be falsely reported accepted and never checked via receipt drain.
- **External contract:** Expo's official send API requires a per-message push ticket with `status:'ok'` **and receipt `id`** for accepted sends; a 200 HTTP transport response alone is not a ticket. https://docs.expo.dev/push-notifications/sending-notifications/#push-tickets
- **Severity:** *provisional P3 delivery integrity/observability*, not a demonstrated live incident; malformed vendor response exposure not tested against actual Expo service. Proposed bounded fix for single-writer lead: require an actual one-element ticket with `status === 'ok'` and a nonempty string `id` before `ok:true`; all other 200 shapes reject with a closed internal error code, preserving the existing explicit error/DeviceNotRegistered path. Add direct actual-module failing controls for empty/missing/primitive/wrong-schema/missing-id and normal positive tickets; keep send-vs-delivered semantics and existing 429/receipt logic.
- **Conflict to review:** existing `__tests__/watchlistPushObservability.test.js` #9 intentionally asserts emitting accepted independently of `ticketId`; update that expectation only as necessary when the adapter contract is corrected. Do not mislabel this missing probe as full QA PASS.

### Additional source candidate: JSON null top-level Watchlist action
- **Location:** `supabase/functions/commerce-watch-refresh/index.ts:936–950`. A syntactically valid JSON `null` satisfies `req.json()` but then `body.action` dereferences null; there is no top-level object guard. An authenticated request can take the uncontrolled exception path rather than the ordinary `invalid_body` 400. Original mandatory null-body cells `B35-MAND-0141` (function) and `B35-MAND-2678` (Watchlist workflow) remain NOT TESTED.
- **Severity:** *provisional P4 controlled-error-handling*, pending actual Deno.serve handler evidence (synthetic auth, no writes); do not count as a new confirmed campaign defect until the failing handler probe proves the full boundary. Recommended guard should reject null, arrays and primitives before `body.action`, preserve auth priority and valid actions.

### Independent executable baseline coverage contribution
[PR #682](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/pull/682) adds isolated actual-TypeScript push-adapter VM tests on a disjoint branch; covers positive tickets, outbound payload bounds, explicit vendor errors, network and HTTP failures. This PR **does not fix or close** either finding above. Exact-head CI is the gate; original 3,096 mandatory matrix and main source repair queue remain untouched.

**Campaign disposition:** AUDIT INCOMPLETE. Agent 1 retains exclusive ownership of F024 mobile -> F025 -> B004 and core handler/manifest/migration changes. No source defect was promoted into a release PASS and no forbidden rollout was undertaken.
